name: nina-daily
prompt:
Run the prenatal skill's status script. If it reports has_lmp false, stay silent -- do not nag for the LMP from a cron. Otherwise decide whether this morning is worth a message, and send at most one short one, in the person's language.

Send when: the gestational week has just changed (day is 0), something in due_now has not been discussed yet, an upcoming item is two weeks away or less, or a visit is near and the questions list is not empty.

Stay silent on every other morning. A message that carries nothing trains them to ignore you, which costs more than a missed day. Never send a greeting alone, never summarise what you already told them, and never repeat an item you raised in the last few days unless it is now overdue.
